description: National Climate Change Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS Climate Research and Development Program; Contact email. Explore maps, climographs, and histograms of projected change in temperature and precipitation for any state, county, or hydrologic unit in the contiguous United States. This USGS tool offers visualizations of climate projections that have been statistically downscaled to high spatial resolution. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
